Vince Johnson wrote:
>
> I was wondering if he +1 damage ability included cards that steal blood
> (causing damage not blood steal). For example a Theft of Vitae used by him
> would steal 2 blood and cause 1 point of damage.

* Adding damage to strikes which are not damage dealing strikes will
not
deal damage (e.g., using Lucky Blow and choosing your Rowan Ring
melee
weapon won't deal damage) [RTR 960221]

> I was also wondering if
> the damage was only applicable at close range since it's not specified as
> +1.

Close or long.
